title: Ladder: clearer comment on nextPosition, plus a test above the top
body:
A small clarity change in the shared ladder code. No behaviour change.

## What changed
- `js/core/ladder.js`: the comment on `nextPosition` said only "The puzzle after this one." It now says how it moves: the next puzzle in the level, the next level after `puzzlesPerLevel` puzzles, and at the top level (or above it) it stays there while `n` keeps counting.
- `tests/unit/ladder.test.js`: one more check in the endless test: from a level above the top, the next puzzle is at the top level.

## How to try it
Nothing to see in the game; `npx vitest run tests/unit/ladder.test.js`.

## Checks
- The new check is inside an existing test, so the test count doesn't change.
- Local `npm run check`: type check passed, 378 unit tests passed, 183 browser tests passed. Visual snapshots skipped locally (they run only on GitHub); no picture should change.
- No decisions changed. No packages added or upgraded.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
why: A comment that now matches what the code does, plus a correct extra assertion; no logic change.
